summary: Retested the redesigned Source-of-Supply (Production Model) picker on /production-confirmation -> 'Create Production Order' (live SAP tenant, synthetic vms_session, deleted after test). BACKEND 9/9 PASSED (/app/backend/tests/test_sos_flat_options.py): GET /api/production-confirmation/source-of-supply-options/{material} now returns a FLAT list of (model, site) combos with 'description' + 'site_id', unscoped when no site_id is passed - HTBS-SPAIN -> 2 combos [(HTBS-SPAIN_1,P2),(HTBS-SPAIN_2,P3)] sorted with P2 first, BK-0021 -> 2 combos both at P2 with distinct logistic_relationship_uuid, MAZ42117272-TA -> exactly 1 active combo, ?site_id=P3 still narrows HTBS-SPAIN to 1 (HTBS-SPAIN_2), bogus material ZZZ-NOT-REAL -> HTTP 200 {material_uuid:null, options:[]}, 401 without cookie. Regression endpoints OK (proposal-history 200, deviation-reasons 200, open-lots 200 / 113 reporting points, 100 lots). FRONTEND: labels now render exactly as designed - 'HTBS-SPAIN_1 - HTBS SPEAKER STAND BLACK (Site P2)' / '(Site P3)', 'BK-0021_1 - BRACKET, TANGENT( Flat-BK21) (Site P2)' / 'BK-0021_2 - BRACKET, TANGENT(SH4.5 HR Sheet) (Site P2)', 'MAZ42117272-TA_1 - Tv Arm Left&Right (Site P2)'. Picker now appears with an EMPTY Site for all 3 materials incl. the single-combo one, and MANUAL selection auto-fills Site correctly (HTBS-SPAIN_2 -> Site becomes P3; BK-0021_2 -> stays P2). Bogus product: no picker, no console errors, Site untouched. Payload check: POST create-and-release-order carried logistic_relationship_uuid=FA163E48-7A8A-1FE1-90D8-89B64583773B for MAZ42117272-TA (picker value flows through). Smoke: open lots (113 rows), Confirm dialog, Confirmation History dialog, Manage Reasons dialog (12 reasons) all render, zero console errors. TWO REAL DEFECTS FOUND on the auto-fill half of the change (see frontend_issues).

minor.issue: MAZ42117272-TA @P2 now ALSO fails the component-stock pre-check: 400 "Can't auto-release - insufficient component stock at P2: MAT (need 0.01, have 0), HRCOIL1.9X80.5 (need 0.49, have unknown)". Real tenant stock data, not a code bug - but it means the suggested 'safe candidate' for a full create+release E2E no longer works, so the end-to-end write path with the picker active could again only be verified at the request-payload level. Note 'have unknown' in the message - the pre-check blocks on materials whose stock it could not read, which may be over-strict.
Still returns 502 (not 400/404) for an unknown site_id - carried over from iteration_83, unfixed.

ui_bugs.issue: AUTO-FILL OF SITE ON LOOKUP DOES NOT WORK (primary requirement of this change). Typing 'HTBS-SPAIN' (or 'BK-0021', or 'MAZ42117272-TA') and blurring shows the picker with the Active default pre-selected in the trigger, but the Site input stays EMPTY (expected 'P2'). Root cause: checkSourceOfSupply() calls chooseSosOption(String(idx)) in the same tick as setSosOptions(options); chooseSosOption reads `sosOptions` from the stale render closure (which was just reset to []), so `option` is undefined and setSiteId(option.site_id) never runs. Fix: pass the option object (or use the freshly fetched `options` array) instead of reading state, e.g. chooseSosOption(idx, options) / setSiteId(options[idx].site_id).

ui_bugs.component: CreateOrderTab / Source of Supply Select (single-option case)
ui_bugs.issue: For a single-combo material (MAZ42117272-TA) the user can NEVER get the Site auto-filled: the lone option is already the selected value, so clicking it in the Radix Select fires no onValueChange -> setSiteId is never called, and Site remains empty. Combined with the bug above, 'Create Production Order' then fails client validation ('Product, Site and Quantity are required') until the user types the Site by hand - i.e. the whole point of 'picking a model auto-fills the site' is lost for single-option materials. Fixing the stale-closure bug above resolves this too.

integration_issues.flow: Second lookup after a model selection has set the Site
integration_issues.issue: Once Site is populated (e.g. P3 after picking HTBS-SPAIN_2), typing a DIFFERENT Product ID and blurring sends site_id=P3, so BK-0021/MAZ42117272-TA (only valid at P2) return 0 options and the picker silently disappears - the user sees no picker and a wrong leftover Site P3, then Create would go to SAP with the wrong site. Reproduced twice. Since the new design says the model determines the site, the product-blur lookup should NOT pass site_id (or should clear the Site when the new material has no combo at the current site).

action_items: Fix the stale-closure bug in checkSourceOfSupply(): derive the site from the freshly fetched options array (not from `sosOptions` state) so the Site auto-fills on lookup - currently it never does, for any material.
Make the single-option case set the Site too (falls out of the fix above; re-clicking the already-selected Radix item fires no onValueChange).

Drop site_id from the product-blur lookup (or clear Site when the new material has no combo at the current Site) so a leftover auto-filled Site from a previous material can't hide the picker / submit the wrong site.
critical_code_review_comments: chooseSosOption() reads React state (`sosOptions`) that was set microseconds earlier in the same handler - classic stale-closure; pass the option object explicitly.
checkSourceOfSupply() still swallows every error silently (no console.warn), so real 502s from the custom OData service are invisible in the field.
ProductionConfirmationPage.js is ~813 lines with 4 dialogs + 2 tabs; CreateOrderTab should be its own module.
seed_data_creation: Temporary auth user/session (testtid:testoid-prodconf2) created via /app/tests/setup_session_prodconf2.py create and deleted with `clean` afterwards. No SAP master data or proposals created (the one real create attempt was rejected by the component-stock pre-check).
test_credentials: No end-user login; Entra SSO simulated with a synthetic vms_session cookie (script: /app/tests/setup_session_prodconf2.py create|clean, token written to /tmp/test_token2.txt).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend flat-combo API is fully correct and covered by /app/backend/tests/test_sos_flat_options.py (9 tests, needs /tmp/test_token2.txt). Frontend: descriptions + site tags + manual-selection auto-fill all verified working; ONLY the automatic auto-fill on lookup (and the single-option click case) is broken - retest by typing HTBS-SPAIN, blurring, and asserting create-proposal-site-input == 'P2' without any manual selection, plus MAZ42117272-TA -> 'P2'. Also retest that switching material after a P3 auto-fill still shows the picker. WARNING: writing/editing any file under /app/backend triggers uvicorn watchfiles reload and ~60s of ingress 502s - create test files first, wait, then run pytest and any UI test. MAZ42117272-TA @P2 now fails the component-stock pre-check too, so no material is currently known to complete a real create+release E2E.
rca_of_the_issue: checkSourceOfSupply() does setSosOptions(options) then immediately calls chooseSosOption(String(idx)); chooseSosOption looks the option up in the `sosOptions` state variable captured by the current render's closure (still the pre-fetch value, which the same function had just reset to []), so `option` is undefined and setSiteId(option.site_id) is skipped. The Select trigger still shows the right label because rendering uses the new state, which masks the failure visually.
